summary: Iter53 test of (1) IP ban list, (2) event edit/cancel, (3) flyer upload, (4) admin header dropdown. BACKEND suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter53_bans_event_edit_flyer.py = 13/14 PASS. IP bans: admin POST /api/admin/ip-bans {203.0.113.9} -> 200 (no _id, banned_by set), GET lists it, GET /api/markets with X-Forwarded-For: 203.0.113.9 -> 403 while the same call without the header -> 200, /api/admin/ip-bans is still reachable from the banned IP (undo path works), DELETE -> 200 {ok:true} and the forwarded request -> 200 again; member POST -> 403, anon GET -> 403, DELETE unknown IP -> 404, blank IP -> 400, admin banning own IP (X-Forwarded-For == body.ip) -> 400 'Refusing to ban your own IP'. Event edit/cancel: partner creates event + crew.alex RSVPs; PATCH {location:'New dock'} -> 200, persists in GET /api/events, alex gets an event_updated notification and the actor (partner) does NOT; alex PATCH -> 404, anon PATCH -> 401; PATCH agg_* event as admin -> 400; PATCH invalid market/starts_at/category -> 400; PATCH image_url of 500k chars -> 400; DELETE -> 200, event gone from GET /api/events, alex gets event_cancelled, registrations wiped. Flyer: small data URL round-trips through POST/GET /api/events. FRONTEND: partner /events edit+cancel flow fully works (event-manage -> edit-event-<id> -> editing-banner + prefilled title/location/start/market, submit label 'Save changes' -> 'Event updated' toast -> row shows 'New dock'; then cancel-event-<id> + confirm -> 'Event cancelled' toast, row gone). Admin /admin/analytics abuse-panel: ban-198.51.100.7 (confirm) -> toast, unban button + ban-list + banned-<ip> chip appear; unban -> toast, chip gone, Ban IP button back. Admin header admin-menu shows all 4 nav-admin-* links with correct hrefs; member (crew.alex) has no admin-menu, no new-event-btn and no event-manage on 6 events checked. List/map/calendar views still render (22 rows). ONE CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: the flyer upload path is broken end-to-end (see rca) and it hard-crashes the React app.

minor.issue: No MAX_PHOTO_URL_CHARS guard on create: image_url of 500,000 chars is accepted and stored (200). PATCH /api/events/{id} correctly returns 400. Add the same `if len(doc.get('image_url') or '') > MAX_PHOTO_URL_CHARS: 400` check in create_event.

ui_bugs.issue: compressImageToDataURL() returns an OBJECT {dataUrl,bytes,chars,quality,cap,ok} but FlyerUploader does onChange(await compressImageToDataURL(file)) — so image_url becomes an object. flyer-preview renders with src='[object Object]' (broken image) and submitting the form sends image_url as an object.

POST /api/events then returns 422 and the FastAPI detail is an ARRAY of objects; toast.error(e.response.data.detail) renders it as a React child -> 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, loc, msg, input, url})' uncaught runtime error that blanks the whole page (dev error overlay). Any 422 from any form will do this — normalize detail to a string before toasting.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot post any event that has a flyer attached — request rejected 422 and the app crashes; event is never created. ProPhotosUploader uses the same helper correctly (reads r.dataUrl), only FlyerUploader is wrong.

issues: Carry-over data noise: multiple aggregator rows still titled 'Book online' (OWSA feed).
One console 401 on page load before the session resolves (cosmetic, pre-existing).

action_items: FlyerUploader.jsx line 14: use the returned object — const r = await compressImageToDataURL(file); if (!r) return toast.error('Couldn't process that image'); if (!r.ok) return toast.error('Image too large even after compression'); onChange(r.dataUrl);

Events.jsx (and any shared api error helper): stringify FastAPI 422 details before toasting, e.g. const msg = Array.isArray(d) ? d.map(x=>x.msg).join(', ') : (typeof d === 'string' ? d : 'Failed'). Consider an app-level ErrorBoundary so a bad toast payload can't blank the page.
Add the MAX_PHOTO_URL_CHARS length check to POST /api/events (create_event) to match PATCH.
critical_code_review_comments: imageCompress.js returns a rich object while one of its two callers treats it as a string — make the contract explicit (return the string and throw/return null on failure, or rename to compressImage()) so this class of bug can't recur.

ipban_router keeps an in-process _BANNED set; with multiple uvicorn workers/pods a ban applied on one worker is not seen by the others until their first load_bans(). Bans/unbans should invalidate across processes (re-read on a TTL or query Mongo per request with a short cache).

ban_middleware runs before auth and short-circuits every /api path except /api/admin/ip-bans — good, but the exemption is path-prefix based, so an admin locked out cannot even call /api/auth/me; the admin UI on /admin/analytics loads other admin endpoints that would 403. Consider exempting /api/auth/* too.

success_rate.frontend: 80% — bans, edit/cancel, admin menu, member gating all pass; flyer upload broken (crashes app)

rca_of_the_issue: Flyer upload: /app/frontend/src/lib/imageCompress.js compressImageToDataURL() resolves to {dataUrl, bytes, chars, quality, cap, ok}. /app/frontend/src/components/FlyerUploader.jsx line 14 passes that object straight to onChange, so Events.jsx draft.image_url is an object: serializes to '[object Object]' (verified: preview src length 15) and POST /api/events sends image_url:{...} -> FastAPI 422 string_type. Events.jsx submit() then calls toast.error(e.response.data.detail) with the 422 detail ARRAY of error objects, which React refuses to render -> 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, loc, msg, input, url})' uncaught error that unmounts the page (blank screen + dev overlay), so the user loses the whole form. Reproduced twice; the identical flow without a flyer creates, edits and cancels events perfectly.
